_comment: Snapshot of the user's Interactive Brokers watchlists, fetched 2026-09-19 via the IBKR MCP tools. Only the five research/trading lists are included; see excluded_watchlists below. Kept as a static file for the same reason as the other config/ JSONs: this app deploys standalone on Vercel with no IBKR credentials or gateway, so it cannot query IBKR at request time. To refresh, re-fetch get_watchlists/get_watchlist through the IBKR MCP connection and rewrite the watchlists array below; `ibkr_id` is the IBKR watchlist id to fetch. Only the symbol is stored — the app joins on ticker, and IBKR contract ids are not used here. A handful of symbols per list (QQQ, a few mega-caps) have no backtest data; the API reports how many of each list's symbols the dataset covers rather than silently dropping them.

excluded_watchlists._reason: Earnings lists excluded by request. The scanner and macro lists (gap/mover scans, index and futures pulse, non-US listings) are excluded both because none of their symbols were backtested — they resolved to zero usable tickers — and to keep day-to-day scan output out of this public repository.
